title: Claude for Teachers, now available for U.S. K-12 schools and districts
summary: Claude for Teachers expands to a free Enterprise offering for schools and districts with centrally managed organizations, SSO, and role-based access controls. New teaching skills for lesson preparation and check-for-understanding (math-focused at launch) join FERPA-compliant data protection, with a full year free for schools signing up by June 30, 2027.

title: Claude gets its own browser in Cowork
summary: Claude Cowork now includes a built-in browser isolated from users' personal browsers—Claude cannot access personal tabs, bookmarks, or credentials unless explicitly imported. Rolling out to Pro, Max, and Team this week with prompt-injection safeguards, while Claude in Chrome handles collaborative web work and shared pages.

title: Claude's memory works everywhere, and you decide what's in it
summary: Claude's memory now syncs consistently across Cowork, chat, web, desktop, and mobile with real-time updates during conversations. Users can view, edit, and delete individual memory topics in settings, with privacy controls that by default exclude sensitive subjects (health, religion, SSNs, criminal records) unless explicitly enabled.

title: Bain & Company joins the Claude Partner Network as a Global Premier partner
summary: Anthropic and Bain & Company announced a strategic partnership combining Claude's capabilities with Bain's 1,500+ AI specialists. Bain has deployed Claude across 19,000 employees and reports 30-50% productivity gains on legacy code modernization, with collaboration expanding to client AI strategy, tech modernization, and operations.

title: How Anthropic employees use Claude Tag
summary: Claude Tag (Claude integrated into Slack) streamlines internal workflows, shifting time from information synthesis to higher-judgment work. Marketing, product ops, and legal teams report 10-100x time savings: document preparation in 45 minutes, week-long data consolidations in hours, and compliance reviews cut from a day to 30 minutes.

title: How Warp builds self-improving agents on Claude
summary: Warp demonstrates self-improving agents using Claude's Skills framework, where paired "base" and "improver" skills institutionalize feedback loops with human oversight through code review. Deployed at scale for spec-writing, review, and triage across Warp's repo, the pattern breaks through agent accuracy plateaus while keeping humans in control.
